2) **Your first name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I confirm your identity, we’ll look up your order and go over the **skateboard return (order ID + which item(s))**.

isabella_johansson_2152

1) The **order ID** (it looks like **#W0000000**)  
2) The **item ID(s)** for the skateboard (or tell me “the skateboard from that order” if there’s only one)

Also, confirm the order is **delivered** (returns are only available for delivered orders).
It’s the skateboard from the delivered order.
